body.zh-Hant: 據近史所的抗戰戰史專文，1941年第二次長沙會戰中，薛岳以第九戰區司令長官身分統率第十九集團軍等部。9月7日日軍展開行動，國軍計畫憑既設陣地逐次抵抗，把日軍主力誘到撈刀河畔；9月27日長沙一度失陷，其後國軍收復失地，稱此役為「第二次長沙大捷」。蔣中正則因長沙一度失陷而深責薛岳。
body.en: The Academia Sinica study of the war against Japan says that in the Second Battle of Changsha in 1941 Xue Yue, as Commander-in-Chief of the Ninth War Zone, led the 19th Army Group and other forces. Japanese forces moved on 7 September, the Chinese plan was to resist in stages from prepared positions and draw the main Japanese force to the Laodao River, and Changsha briefly fell on 27 September. The Chinese then recovered the lost ground and called the battle the Second Changsha Victory, but Chiang Kai-shek blamed Xue Yue for the temporary loss of the city.

citations.quote: 國軍由第九戰區司令長官薛岳統率第十九集團軍、第三十集團軍、第二十七集團軍

heading.zh-Hant: 第一次長沙會戰與天鑪戰法
heading.en: First Battle of Changsha and the "heavenly furnace" tactic

body.zh-Hant: 第一次長沙會戰時，薛岳為第九戰區代司令長官，反對輕易放棄陣地，爭辯甚力；但桂林行營主任白崇禧的命令轉達後，薛不得已下令撤退。此役中方稱為「第一次長沙大捷」，薛岳也因此大捷聲譽卓著，並把防守長沙的戰略稱作「天鑪戰法」。
body.en: During the First Battle of Changsha Xue Yue, acting commander-in-chief of the Ninth War Zone, argued hard against giving up positions lightly, but after Bai Chongxi's order was relayed to him he reluctantly ordered a withdrawal. The Chinese side called the battle the First Changsha Victory; Xue Yue's reputation rose greatly because of it, and he named his strategy for defending Changsha the "heavenly furnace" tactic.

citations.quote: 第九戰區代司令長官薛岳則反對輕易放棄陣地，抗辯甚力
薛不得已，下令撤退
中方稱「第一次長沙大捷」
薛岳也以此大捷，聲譽卓著
稱作「天鑪戰法」

heading.zh-Hant: 豫東兵團與地方軍政職務
heading.en: Eastern Henan group and regional posts

body.zh-Hant: 徐州會戰結束後，薛岳出任豫東兵團總指揮，統率第七十四軍等3個軍迎擊日軍。依公報記錄，他於1935年2月21日獲特派為貴州綏靖主任，1939年1月21日任湖南省政府主席，同年2月7日兼湖南全省保安司令；湖南省主席一職於1945年6月26日獲准辭去。1949年12月28日，他又獲特派為海南防衛總司令。
body.en: After the Xuzhou campaign ended, Xue Yue served as general commander of the Eastern Henan group, leading three corps including the 74th Army against the Japanese. Gazette records show he was appointed Guizhou Pacification Director on 21 February 1935, chairman of the Hunan provincial government on 21 January 1939, and concurrently Hunan provincial security commander on 7 February 1939; his resignation as Hunan chairman was recorded on 26 June 1945. On 28 December 1949 he was appointed commander-in-chief of the Hainan defence command (gazette announcement dates).

body.zh-Hant: 閻錫山為山西五台人，1909年畢業於日本陸軍士官學校步兵科。辛亥革命時舉兵，民國成立後出任山西都督，此後長期掌握山西實權，被稱為「山西王」。日本大百科全書稱他在1917至1927年、1932至1937年間倡導「山西門羅主義」，推動風俗改革與工礦振興。
body.en: Yan Xishan, a native of Wutai in Shanxi, graduated from the Japanese Army Academy's infantry course in 1909. He raised troops during the 1911 Revolution, became military governor of Shanxi after the Republic was founded and held real power in the province for decades, earning the nickname "King of Shanxi". The Nippon Encyclopedia says that in 1917–1927 and 1932–1937 he advocated a "Shanxi Monroe Doctrine", pursuing customs reform and the promotion of industry and mining.

citations.quote: 1909年（明治42）日本の陸軍士官学校歩兵科を卒業。

citations.locator: ブリタニカ国際大百科事典
citations.quote: 辛亥革命の際挙兵し，中華民国成立後山西都督となり，その後の 38年間山西省の実権を握った。
以後独自の建設計画を遂行しつつ山西を地盤に独立した政治勢力を築き，〈山西王〉とよばれた。
とくに1917～1927年、1932～1937年には「山西モンロー主義」を唱え、風俗改革、工鉱業振興に努めたが

heading.en: Warlord governor, the Northern Expedition and the anti-Chiang war

body.zh-Hant: 依公報記錄，閻錫山於1916年7月6日特任為山西省督軍；1928年2月28日特任為國民革命軍第三集團軍總司令，3月9日兼任山西省政府主席，6月4日任京津衛戍總司令，10月24日任內政部長，1929年10月28日任陸海空軍副司令。世界大百科事典稱他1930年與馮玉祥等發動反蔣戰爭而失敗。
body.en: Gazette records show Yan Xishan was appointed Shanxi military governor on 6 July 1916; on 28 February 1928 commander-in-chief of the Third Army Group of the National Revolutionary Army, on 9 March 1928 concurrently chairman of the Shanxi provincial government, on 4 June 1928 garrison commander of Beijing and Tianjin, on 24 October 1928 Minister of the Interior, and on 28 October 1929 deputy commander of the army, navy and air force (gazette announcement dates). The World Encyclopedia says he launched an anti-Chiang war with Feng Yuxiang and others in 1930 and failed.

heading.en: Second War Zone and the Battle of Taiyuan

body.zh-Hant: 抗戰期間閻錫山為第二戰區司令長官，中共第十八集團軍歸他指揮配合平型關作戰。太原會戰中，日軍攻克娘子關後，他令忻口守軍向太原以北轉移，並令傅作義部守太原城，其後日軍攻陷太原。公報記錄顯示，他於1949年6月6日被提任為行政院長，1950年3月10日呈請辭職（窗外，僅記正文）。
body.en: During the war against Japan Yan Xishan was commander-in-chief of the Second War Zone, and the Communist 18th Army Group was placed under his command for the Pingxingguan fighting. In the Battle of Taiyuan, after the Japanese took Niangzi Pass, he ordered the Xinkou defenders to shift north of Taiyuan and told Fu Zuoyi's army to hold the city, and the Japanese then took Taiyuan. Gazette records show he was nominated Premier on 6 June 1949 and resigned on 10 March 1950 (outside the 1908–1945 window; narrative only).

heading.en: Early life and the Red Army years

body.zh-Hant: 陳毅為四川樂至人。據世界大百科事典，他1919年與周恩來、鄧小平等赴法勤工儉學，1923年加入中國共產黨，1927年參加南昌起義；1928年5月在井岡山與毛澤東部隊會合，紅四軍成立。紅軍放棄中央根據地後，他留下率部在廣東、湖南交界地區進行三年艱苦的游擊戰。
body.en: Chen Yi was a native of Lezhi, Sichuan. According to the World Encyclopedia he went to France in 1919 as a work-study student with Zhou Enlai and Deng Xiaoping, joined the Chinese Communist Party in 1923 and took part in the 1927 Nanchang Uprising; in May 1928 he joined Mao Zedong's forces at Jinggangshan, where the Fourth Red Army was formed. After the Red Army abandoned the central base he led remaining troops in three years of hard guerrilla war on the Guangdong–Hunan border.

citations.quote: 1919年苦学生として周恩来，鄧小平らとフランスに留学。23年中国共産党に入党。27年南昌蜂起に参加。
28年5月井岡山で毛沢東部隊と合流，紅4軍が成立した。
広東，湖南省境地区で3年の苦難の遊撃戦争を続けた。

heading.en: The New Fourth Army and the Huangqiao battle

body.zh-Hant: 1937年國共合作編成新四軍時，陳毅被任為第1支隊司令，在江蘇南部建立茅山根據地。1940年他率粟裕等進出長江北岸，10月在黃橋戰役中擊敗國民黨軍韓德勤部，鞏固江北根據地。1941年皖南事變後，他接替葉挺出任新四軍軍長（日本大百科全書則稱代理軍長）。
body.en: When the New Fourth Army was formed under the 1937 Nationalist–Communist cooperation Chen Yi was named commander of its First Detachment and built the Maoshan base in southern Jiangsu. In 1940 he led Su Yu and others to the north bank of the Yangtze and in October defeated Han Deqin's Nationalist forces at the Huangqiao battle, consolidating the northern Jiangsu base. After the Wannan Incident of 1941 he succeeded Ye Ting as commander of the New Fourth Army (the Nippon Encyclopedia calls him acting commander).

citations.quote: 37年国共合作で新四軍が編成されると，各地の残留紅軍を糾合する任にあたり，第1支隊司令に任ぜられ
江蘇省南部に茅山根拠地を建設した。
10月黄橋の戦で国民党政府軍の韓徳勤軍を破り，江北根拠地を固めた。
41年皖南（かんなん）事変が起こると，葉挺のあとをうけて新四軍軍長に任ぜられ
新四軍の支隊司令・代理軍長を務め、

body.zh-Hant: 世界大百科事典記載，1946年起的國共內戰中，陳毅任華東野戰軍司令，後任第三野戰軍司令，在濟南攻略與淮海戰役中立功；1955年解放軍設階級制時，他是十大元帥之一，1958年繼周恩來專任總理後出任外交部長（均在1908–1945年窗外，僅記正文）。
body.en: The World Encyclopedia records that in the civil war from 1946 Chen Yi served as commander of the East China Field Army and then of the Third Field Army, distinguishing himself in the capture of Jinan and the Huaihai campaign; when ranks were introduced in the PLA in 1955 he was one of the ten marshals, and in 1958 he became foreign minister after Zhou Enlai took the premiership alone (all outside the 1908–1945 window; narrative only).

55年解放軍に階級制を設けた際には10人の元帥の一人に任ぜられた。

heading.zh-Hant: 出身與剿共、軍政部任職
heading.en: Background, the anti-Communist campaigns and the War Ministry

body.zh-Hant: 據世界大百科事典，陳誠為浙江青田人，1920年加入中國國民黨，1922年自保定軍官學校畢業，歷任師長、軍長。公報記錄顯示，他於1934年2月13日獲特派為贛粵閩湘鄂剿匪軍北路前敵總指揮；1936年12月2日任軍政部常務次長，1938年1月27日另有任用而免該職。
body.en: According to the World Encyclopedia, Chen Cheng was a native of Qingtian, Zhejiang, joined the Kuomintang in 1920, graduated from the Baoding Military Academy in 1922 and served as division and army commander. Gazette records show he was appointed front-line general commander of the northern route of the Jiangxi–Guangdong–Fujian–Hunan–Hubei bandit-suppression forces on 13 February 1934, became standing vice-minister of military administration on 2 December 1936, and was relieved of that post for another assignment on 27 January 1938 (gazette announcement dates).

heading.en: Battle of Shanghai and the Battle of Wuhan

body.zh-Hant: 淞滬戰事中，陳誠指揮的第十五集團軍各部於24日陸續到達，加入左翼，在羅店附近與登陸日軍激戰。武漢會戰時，6月14日成立的第九戰區由司令長官陳誠（兼武漢衛戍總司令）負責，下轄2個兵團、26個軍。公報記錄顯示，他於1938年6月15日任湖北省政府主席，1944年7月22日被免本兼各職。
body.en: In the fighting at Shanghai, the units of the 15th Army Group under Chen Cheng arrived on the 24th, joined the left wing and fought a fierce battle near Luodian against the Japanese landing force. In the Battle of Wuhan the Ninth War Zone, established on 14 June, was under Commander-in-Chief Chen Cheng (also Wuhan garrison commander) with two army groups and 26 corps. Gazette records show he became chairman of the Hubei provincial government on 15 June 1938 and was relieved of his posts on 22 July 1944 (gazette announcement dates).

heading.zh-Hant: 長沙會戰、軍政部長與戰後
heading.en: Changsha, War Minister and the postwar years

body.zh-Hant: 第一次長沙會戰期間，蔣中正命第九戰區司令長官陳誠偕白崇禧入湘，協助薛岳處置戰事。公報記錄顯示，陳誠於1944年11月20日特任為軍政部長；戰後1946年5月31日特任國防部參謀總長，並同日任海軍總司令。世界大百科事典另記他其後任台灣省政府主席、行政院長與副總統（窗外，僅記正文）。
body.en: During the First Battle of Changsha, Chiang Kai-shek ordered Chen Cheng, then commander-in-chief of the Ninth War Zone, to go to Hunan with Bai Chongxi and help Xue Yue handle matters. Gazette records show Chen was appointed Minister of Military Administration on 20 November 1944 and, after the war, Chief of the General Staff of the National Defence Ministry and commander-in-chief of the navy on 31 May 1946. The World Encyclopedia adds that he later served as Taiwan provincial chairman, Premier and Vice President (outside the window; narrative only).

heading.en: Early career and defending Sun Yat-sen

body.zh-Hant: 據國防部網站所載陳降任文，陳策為廣東瓊山人，1894年生，後轉入廣東水師學堂，並加入同盟會。孫中山於陳炯明叛變時被困，陳策與永豐艦等在圍困中苦撐五十五天。公報記錄顯示，他於1923年3月14日任廣東海防司令，1924年1月16日免職。
body.en: According to an article by Chen Jiangren on the Ministry of National Defense website, Chen Ce was a native of Qiongshan, Guangdong, born in 1894, who moved to the Guangdong naval college and joined the Tongmenghui. When Chen Jiongming rebelled, Chen Ce and the Yongfeng and other ships held out through a siege lasting fifty-five days. Gazette records show he became commander of the Guangdong coastal defence on 14 March 1923 and was dismissed on 16 January 1924 (gazette announcement dates).

citations.quote: 陳策廣東瓊山人，生於遜清光緒20（1894）
遂轉入廣東水師學堂就讀
毅然加入同盟會
在判軍團團圍困之中苦撐力戰五十五天之久

heading.zh-Hant: 海軍第四艦隊與黨政軍職
heading.en: Fourth Fleet and party and military posts

body.zh-Hant: 公報記錄顯示，陳策於1929年5月4日任海軍第四艦隊司令，1934年4月4日任軍事委員會第二廳海軍事務處處長，1936年8月3日任虎門要塞司令（公報公告日）。國防部網站文章另稱他自民國18年（1929年）以後迭任國民黨中央執行委員，民國21年（1932年）秋赴歐美考察軍事。
body.en: Gazette records show Chen Ce was appointed commander of the Navy's Fourth Fleet on 4 May 1929, head of the naval affairs office of the Second Department of the Military Affairs Commission on 4 April 1934 and commander of the Humen fortress on 3 August 1936 (gazette announcement dates). The Ministry of National Defense article adds that from the 18th year of the Republic (1929) he served repeatedly as a Kuomintang Central Executive Committee member and in autumn of the 21st year (1932) went to Europe and America to study military affairs.

heading.en: Humen defence and the Hong Kong breakout

body.zh-Hant: 據同一篇文章，抗戰軍興後陳策受命出任虎門要塞司令，力阻日軍海軍由珠江進攻廣州；次年春他因左腳血管硬化症請辭赴港。1941年12月8日太平洋戰爭爆發，12月25日英軍告知無法再抵抗，陳策決計突圍，終於率隊抵達惠州，事後英方頒贈他K.B.E.爵士勳位。
body.en: The same article says that after the war with Japan began Chen Ce was ordered to command the Humen fortress and blocked the Japanese navy's advance up the Pearl River towards Guangzhou; the following spring he resigned because of arteriosclerosis in his left leg and went to Hong Kong. The Pacific War broke out on 8 December 1941; on 25 December the British told him they could no longer resist, and Chen Ce decided to break out. He eventually reached Huizhou, and the British later conferred on him the K.B.E.

citations.quote: 民國26年抗戰軍興，陳策受命出任虎門要塞司令，力阻日本海軍由珠江進攻廣州
次年春，陳策因左腳患有血管硬化症，請辭後赴港
就在12月25日耶誕節，陳策接到英軍電話，說英軍已無法抵抗
本人決計突圍
終於抵達惠州城
頒贈陳策將軍K.B.E.爵士勳位
